claims.claim_text: For every fixed M, deterministic uniform Exact Triangle has a saving delta_M independent of c; complete cyclic-product inputs and all charged operations.
Majdoddin Theorem 21.3 and Corollary 21.7(a) supply the elementary-group case.
Majdoddin Remark 21.8 identifies lift-carry and re-gauging obstacles.
Majdoddin Propositions 21.9 and 21.10 cover few quotient-zero triangles and limited incident residue diversity.
Majdoddin Open Problem 21.12 asks the unrestricted bounded-exponent question, including Z_4^d.
CVX23 Theorem 5.1 has a hitting/frequency decomposition, cubic initial witness sorting and a faster update cost.
Edgewise potential equations underlie the cited CVX construction.
Generic detection/all-edge/listing relationships are prior work discussed by SWX26.
The new quotient/kernel extension handles every fixed exponent, including dense quotient-zero, residue-diverse inputs.
Order bound gives d<=c log_2 n and charged O_{M,c}(log(n+2)) coordinate operations.
Cyclic embedding is injective, preserves zero sums, costs O_{M,c}(n^2 log(n+2)) and has ambient order n^(c log_2 M).
Majdoddin Theorem 21.3 gives O(p^6 b^(3-epsilon gamma) log^6 b) with the stated polynomial-order hypothesis.
Majdoddin Corollary 9.1(b) and Section 16 instantiate H(1/14,0.077), product 0.0055, yielding conservative epsilon_0=1/1000.
For fixed p the source restriction p<=b^(epsilon/4) excludes a finite range handled directly.
Three independent absence markers encode exactly the present triangles, including characteristic two; construction O(b^2(D+3)).
Capped witnesses are exactly min(t_ij,T), distinct and genuine, in O-tilde(n^(3-epsilon_0 theta/6)).
Cutoff b_0 retains polynomial-order promises at every queried dimension; positive leaf scan and all control costs fit the claimed bound.
Greedy witnesses, hitting sets and frequency scans have stated sizes and charged construction bounds.
Quotient-zero triangles partition disjointly into exceptions and O-tilde(s^3) pieces, with the specified edgewise potentials.
Arbitrary potential lifts cancel exactly; dividing pZ_M by p gives Z_q even for non-split extensions.
Complete marked kernel instances preserve precisely original zero triangles, meet polynomial order, and cost O-tilde(n^2) each.
Induction covers all M and all small/trivial/empty cases, terminates, and uses no advice or preprocessed universe.
All ledger costs including every materialized instance imply delta_M=delta_q/144000 with polylog slack.
Exact verifier checked 512 capped-listing instances, sides 0..3.
Exact verifier checked 676333 potential/kernel cases for composite M<=36 and proper prime divisors.
Exact verifier checked 3548440 marker cases for 2<=q<=36.
Exact verifier checked 360 seeded graph cases, sides 1..6, dimensions 1..3, yielding 6850 kernel instances.
Exact verifier checked 2047 exact exponent ledgers for 2<=M<=2048.
These finite tests use brute-force detectors and establish finite semantic coverage, not the infinite algorithmic theorem.
